main_body: Three stacked cheese wheels: one smaller wheel on top of two side-by-side wheels, all in yellow tones
top_band: At x=8, rows 3-5 are light yellow (#eac65a edge, then #f4dd85 on rows 4-5), which is 2 clear light rows plus an edge row. The lower wheels have only a 1-2 row light band (row 10, or rows 9-10 at x=12).
evidence: The upper wheel has a 3-row top and a 3-row front, and the dark row 9 reads as a shadow. The two lower wheels are the larger volume, and their tops are only 1-2 rows, so they read as thin rims over a flat front. They are drawn as boxy blocks with straight vertical fronts, not as cylinders with ellipse tops. Because the main body of the lower tier has no real visible top surface, it fails as a round body.

style.evidence: The piece has only 4 distinct colours and a median of 4 per tile, against 17 and 20 for the references. It uses three shading steps: highlight, mid yellow and a dark brown-yellow. The outline is tinted brown, so it is not near-black. There is no grain, speckle or per-wheel texture such as rind marks, and the front faces are smooth fills. It is much thinner than the references.
